name: Sequencer Event Poller
description: MCP server for Sequencer Event Poller. Replies, bounces, unsubscribes, meetings, and LinkedIn replies from your own Instantly, Smartlead, HeyReach, and lemlist accounts, one row per event. Read only. Runs on Apify.
author: Mamba Labs

HEYREACH_API_KEY.description: Optional. Your own HeyReach API key

LEMLIST_API_KEY.description: Optional. Your own lemlist API key
